description: Defines the API, data structures, macros, and inline functions for the Real-Time IO (RTIO) subsystem in Zephyr OS, including submission and completion queue management, operation preparation, and device interface.

methods.name: rtio_mempool_block_size
methods.description: Returns the size of each memory block in the RTIO context's memory pool.

methods.name: __rtio_compute_mempool_block_index
methods.description: Calculates the index of the memory pool block corresponding to a given pointer.

methods.name: rtio_cqe_get_mempool_buffer
methods.description: Retrieves the buffer associated with a completion queue event if it was allocated from the RTIO mempool.

methods.name: rtio_release_buffer
methods.description: Releases a buffer allocated from the RTIO mempool back to the pool.

methods.name: rtio_sqe_prep_read
methods.description: Prepares a submission queue entry for a read operation.

methods.name: rtio_sqe_prep_read_with_pool
methods.description: Prepares a read operation with buffer allocated from the RTIO mempool.

methods.name: rtio_sqe_prep_read_multishot
methods.description: Prepares a multi-shot read operation.

methods.name: rtio_sqe_prep_write
methods.description: Prepares a write operation.

methods.name: rtio_sqe_prep_tiny_write
methods.description: Prepares a tiny write operation with data copied into the SQE.

methods.name: rtio_sqe_prep_callback
methods.description: Prepares a callback operation.

methods.name: rtio_sqe_prep_transceive
methods.description: Prepares a transceive (read/write) operation.

methods.name: rtio_sqe_pool_alloc
methods.description: Allocates a submission queue entry from the pool.

methods.name: rtio_sqe_pool_free
methods.description: Frees a submission queue entry back to the pool.

methods.name: rtio_cqe_pool_alloc
methods.description: Allocates a completion queue event from the pool.

methods.name: rtio_cqe_pool_free
methods.description: Frees a completion queue event back to the pool.

methods.name: rtio_block_pool_alloc
methods.description: Allocates a buffer from the RTIO memory block pool.

methods.name: rtio_block_pool_free
methods.description: Frees a buffer back to the RTIO memory block pool.

methods.name: rtio_sqe_copy_in_get_handles
methods.description: Copies SQEs into the RTIO queue and returns handles for cancellation.

methods.name: rtio_cqe_copy_out
methods.description: Copies completed CQEs from the RTIO queue with optional timeout.

methods.name: rtio_submit
methods.description: Submits queued RTIO operations to the executor for processing.
